name: Trulioo
tagline: Global identity and business verification (KYC/KYB) across 100+ countries.
description: Trulioo provides identity verification, business verification, and KYC/KYB APIs covering 100+ countries. Developers use it to verify individuals and businesses against government and commercial data sources for onboarding, compliance, and fraud prevention. Authentication is typically API key or OAuth-based via their developer portal.

auth.details: API credentials from Trulioo developer portal; typically username/password or API key depending on product (GlobalGateway vs others). Confirm in current docs.

use_cases: verify an individual's identity for KYC onboarding
verify a business entity for KYB compliance
check document authenticity for identity verification
screen customers against watchlists for AML
